chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me from Abul Qasim al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Kufi, who reported from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Marwan, who reported from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Hashimi, from Abdul Mu'min, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, who reported from Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:

"The nearest of you to me on the Day of Reckoning tomorrow will be the most truthful of you in speech, and the most ardent of you in paying back the deposits entrusted to you, and the most faithful of you in fulfilling your promises, and the best of you in your behaviour, and the nearest of you to the people."

key_terms.الموقف: The Standing; the station of the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: Who will be nearest to the Prophet on the Day of Reckoning?
ai.summary: The Prophet (S) teaches that on the Day of Reckoning, those nearest to him will be distinguished by five qualities: truthfulness in speech, trustworthiness in returning deposits, faithfulness in keeping promises, excellence of character, and amiability toward people. This hadith, transmitted via Imam al-Baqir (AS) from Jabir al-Ansari, emphasizes moral virtues over ritual acts as the measure of proximity to the Prophet.
word_analysis: and the most diligent of you
and the most faithful of you
